name: Fluorophenibut
summary: An anxiolytic analogue of GABA and phenibut, with similar activity to the latter. Suggested to be 5-10x potent as phenibut, with some preliminary reports indicating tolerance builds more slowly.

pharmacology.text: 4-Fluorophenibut (developmental code name CGP-11130; also known as β-(4-fluorophenyl)-γ-aminobutyric acid or β-(4-fluorophenyl)-GABA) is a GABAB receptor agonist which was never marketed. It is less potent as a GABAB receptor agonist than baclofen but more potent than phenibut.

summaryZh: 4-氨基-3-(4-氟苯基)丁酸或β-氨基甲基-4-氟苯丙酸（研發代號CGP-11130）是一種有機化合物，化學式為C10H12FNO2。它是GABAB受體激動劑，但從未上市。它可由4-硝基-3-(4-氟苯基)丁醛經氧化至羧酸，再由硼氫化鈉還原硝基，調節pH至3~4得到。
